verdict.rationale: Circle is stablecoin payments and wallet infrastructure (APIs, SDKs, CLI), not an agent or AI host that consumes MCP servers, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Its documented official MCP server and Claude Code skills are server-side and plugin offerings for other agents, not evidence that Circle itself plugs in third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
